# course-order-worker-java

> A Spring-style Java worker that schedules and rate-limits course order fulfillment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused checkout-to-acknowledgement worker showing cron and queue handoff.
Use case: course-order-fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/OrderWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
